title: Cost Slicer Atelier — role-aware token breakdown, pricing pattern library & export flows
creator: Ava Morales
description: Problem: Customers need a concise, role-aware way to inspect token-level spend and export curated views for finance and engineering. Scope: design a compact token-cost breakdown card, an expandable session rollup row, a small library of pricing UI patterns (slab, per-token, session-credit), and CSV/JSON export templates that respect RBAC and billing group filters. Deliverables: Figma prototype for console list + detail, spec for export schema, role-aware column rules, and handoff notes for ENG+PM.
acceptance_criteria: Compact token breakdown card available in per-route list and session detail screens
Export templates (CSV/JSON) include role-filtered columns and a reproducible header mapping
Pricing pattern gallery shows slab, rate-band, and bundled-session variants with examples
Design handoff includes component tokens, accessibility notes, and sample dataset for QA
Performance: UI decisions do not exceed 150ms render budget in mock harness
decisions: Primary export format: CSV by default, JSON as advanced option (customer request); both include schema version header
Role-aware columns: Finance sees unit cost, aggregated charge lines; Eng sees model, sequence-length histogram, KV cache hit-rate
Default breakdown: per-invocation row with expandable session rollup to avoid list noise
Pricing patterns: include 'slab' and 'dynamic per-token' as canonical examples; session-credit shown as badge and as conversion column
To minimize back-end changes, export will rely on existing metrics endpoints with a small adapter layer for column mapping
tradeoffs: Full per-token export would be large for high-volume customers — we opt for configurable sampling + full-export-as-BLOB for enterprise
Showing KV cache metrics inline increases cognitive load; moved to an optional expanded panel to keep primary card simple
Role-aware exports add complexity to permissioning logic; initial rollout will support three personas (Admin, Finance, Eng) and expand later
